## Restore 0.1.89 menu navigation

- Restore the original menu-bar, drawer, remote focus policy and direct content-to-menu focus requests used in 0.1.89-beta.
- Remove the navigation overrides and recovery changes introduced in 0.1.90 through 0.1.93.
- Preserve all unrelated playback, thumbnail, cloud-sync and Continue Watching fixes.

Signed 32-bit release build. This is a menu-only rollback, not a full application downgrade.
